description: This file defines a final utility class 'CredentialsMessageFilter' that provides a static method to verify the validity of credential API messages by checking required properties in an AMQP message.

classes.name: CredentialsMessageFilter
classes.description: A utility class that provides a method to verify if a credential message contains all necessary properties for processing.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies if the provided AMQP message contains all required properties such as message ID or correlation ID, a valid subject, a reply-to address, and a data body.
